headline: Recount of votes on a statutory question from the November 3, 2026 municipal election.
summary: City Clerk Daniel Healey asked for a recount of votes on a statutory question required by HB 1300, Chapter 324, 2026. Items also cover the canvass of returns from the November 3, 2026 Municipal General Election.
items: Communication from City Clerk Daniel Healey about a recount request for the statutory question required by HB1300, Chapter 324, 2026
Discussion of the canvass of returns from the November 3, 2026 Municipal General Election
Request for a recount of votes cast for the statutory question required by HB 1300, Chapter 324, 2026
